say:1:1821341001:1.text: Senea, I finally found the meteor dust and ocean mercury for your Memory Stars!
say:1:1821341001:1.source_cn: 塞涅小姐，我终于替你找到了你需要的制作记忆之星的材料—...

say:2:1821341002:1.text: You have no idea how many hoops I had to jump through to get those two! I spent ages talking that merchant into selling them to me, then ran all over the city. My legs almost gave out...
say:2:1821341002:1.source_cn: 为了买到这两样东西，我可是软磨硬泡了那商人好久，又在城...

say:3:1821341003:1.text: I really appreciate everything you've done, Rotwin. If you need a new pair of legs, I'll cover the cost.
say:3:1821341003:1.source_cn: 感谢你的协助，腐莱维先生。如果你需要更换双腿，我会为你...

say:4:1821341004:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you take a look at these materials and see if they'll work?

say:9:1821341006:1.text: Hah, of course! I bet no one else in Novaris could've pulled this off!
say:9:1821341006:1.source_cn: 哼，那是当然的了！谁让我是最神通广大的道具师呢，哈哈！
say:9:1821341006:1.male: Hah, of course! I bet no one else in Novaris could've pulled this off!
say:9:1821341006:1.female: Hah, of course! I bet no one else in Novaris could've pulled this off!

say:10:1821341007:1.text: By the way, Senea, will I have the honor of seeing what's inside the Memory Stars once they're finished?
say:10:1821341007:1.source_cn: 对了，塞涅小姐，那颗所谓的记忆之星完成以后，能不能让我看看？

say:11:1821341008:1.text: Um... I don't mean to pry, but I'm just curious how they work. It might give me some inspiration for new creations.
say:11:1821341008:1.source_cn: 啊……我不是想窥探你的记忆，只是想研究一下它的造型和魔...

say:13:1821341010:1.text: But for now, I still have no clue how to activate the Memory Stars to replay my memories.
say:13:1821341010:1.source_cn: 只是此刻我也并不清楚该如何打开记忆之星，让它重现曾经的...

say:20:1821341014:1.text: Well, if <style="stress"><player_name></style> thinks that's the best approach, I'd be grateful if you'd lend us a hand, Rotwin.

say:21:1821341015:1.text: No problem! It's an honor to help you, Senea!
say:21:1821341015:1.source_cn: 当然当然。能帮上塞涅小姐你的忙，是我的荣幸啊！

say:22:1821341016:1.text: And if you have any design requests in mind, just let me know! I'll do my best to make it happen!
say:22:1821341016:1.source_cn: 如果你需要什么特殊的造型，也尽管告诉我！保证完成得又快又好！

say:23:1821341017:1.text: I can't thank you enough, Rotwin.
say:23:1821341017:1.source_cn: 再次感谢你，腐莱维先生。

say:24:1821341018:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I will be working on the Memory Star soon. Could you please let everyone know that we'd rather not be disturbed for a while?
